subject: Post-demo load replay & acceptance checklist for HelixPay onboarding
messages:
From: Luke Harper <luke.harper@helixpay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+onboarding@helixpay.com
Date: 2026-11-23 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Quick: post-demo load replay window and artifacts

Thanks for the demo today — the HelixPay infra team wants to run a recorded traffic replay against the Redwood staging endpoint so we can validate tail latency and token throughput at our expected peak. A few asks from our side: 
- Can you share the exact traffic pattern you used in the demo (mix of chat vs. completion, average seq len)?
- We want to run 2 replays: one matching demo patterns, one at 2x concurrent sessions for stress.
- Can you provide a target acceptance checklist (latency percentiles, error budget, and throughput targets) so we can annotate the results?

If possible, we'd like to run the first replay Wednesday morning (our time). Sending ops+onboarding for scheduling.

—Luke
Luke Harper
Lead SRE, HelixPay

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Luke Harper <luke.harper@helixpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, ops+onboarding@helixpay.com
Date: 2026-11-23 11:06:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick: post-demo load replay window and artifacts

Thanks Luke — good plan. Attached are the artifacts to run the replay and the acceptance matrix. Highlights below: 

Replay artifacts attached: helixpay_load_script_v1.yml (K6-style traffic file) — includes:
- mix: 60% chat-style streaming (avg seq len 230 tokens), 40% simple completions (avg 90 tokens)
- user think time distribution + auth header stub

Acceptance checklist (attached acceptance-sla-matrix.xlsx) — target SLOs for this run:
- p50: < 40ms per token
- p95: < 120ms per token
- p99: < 400ms per token
- error rate: < 0.5% (5xx + 429)
- sustained throughput: 28k tokens/sec across cluster for baseline run; 56k tokens/sec for 2x stress run

Run plan: 
1) Baseline replay (demo pattern) — 30 min warmup, 60 min steady window.
2) Stress replay (2x concurrency) — 15 min warmup, 45 min steady window.
3) Telemetry: please export per-request latencies (+KV cache hit rate) and the transcript sample we discussed.

We’ll have Monica on the call for telemetry export and Ben for commercial/signoff items. Suggest calendar: Wed 2026-11-25 10:00-12:00 ET for baseline + quick handoff to run stress at 13:30 ET. Please confirm.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Luke Harper <luke.harper@helixpay.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, ops+onboarding@helixpay.com
Date: 2026-11-24 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick: post-demo load replay window and artifacts

Adding a quick commercial checklist so we can align acceptance to the commit: 
- If the baseline run meets the acceptance matrix, Redwood will issue the onboarding readiness note and enable the dedicated staging slot for your production switch-over testing.
- If stress run breaches the p99 target but error rate remains <0.5%, we recommend a joint review and a tuned batching/quantization profile before signoff.
- If errors exceed acceptance or sustained throughput is <85% of target, we’ll joint-triage immediately and pause signoff.

Operational asks (to Helix ops): 
- Ensure the replay uses service account credentials (ops+onboarding) to avoid rate-limit collisions.
- Share a link to where you’ll drop the replay results CSV and raw k6 logs; we’ll pull traces from our side to correlate.

See you on Wednesday — Ben will join for the wrap call and to confirm next steps.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success / Onboarding, Redwood Inference

From: Luke Harper <luke.harper@helixpay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, ops+onboarding@helixpay.com
Date: 2026-11-25 16:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick: post-demo load replay window and artifacts

Thanks all — we ran both replays and uploaded the artifacts to the shared Drive link (see related links). Quick summary from the CSV (attached replay-results-20261125.csv):
- Baseline run (60m steady): avg throughput 29.1k tokens/sec; p50=33ms, p95=98ms, p99=360ms; error rate=0.18%
- Stress run (45m steady at 2x concurrency): avg throughput 51.8k tokens/sec; p50=41ms, p95=138ms, p99=620ms; error rate=0.9% (primarily 429s during a 7-minute spike)

Observations / asks: 
- Baseline: meets acceptance matrix — looks good for onboarding signoff.
- Stress: p99 and error rate exceed targets. We can schedule a tuning session but we need guidance on quick mitigations (batch size cap, KV cache warm strategies, or a fallback model variant) before we flip the staging slot.

Next steps: 
1) Redwood to propose a tuning run plan (small config changes, 30-min validation).
2) If that reduces 429 spike and p99 < 500ms, HelixPay will mark onboarding as "ready for staging traffic".

Attaching the CSV and logs for your analysis.

—Luke Harper
Lead SRE, HelixPay
